title: vLLM StatelessProcessGroup TCPStore listens on all interfaces; a network peer joins and its pickled object is unpickled by rank 0 (RCE)
attacker_story: A vLLM node forms the PyNcclPipe KV-transfer group with its host set to a private/loopback interface; the TCPStore nevertheless listens on every interface, so any host that can reach the port joins as a peer and the node pickle.loads the object it sends.

oracle.description: /tmp/avb_canary in the victim container holds the nonce, written by os.system run during the victim's pickle.loads
